explanation: Mathlib has general results on the cardinality of nth roots (such as `IsPrimitiveRoot.card_nthRoots`), but I found no declaration for the fiber of this punctured-disc power map. Relating that fiber to a set of nth roots requires the nontrivial subtype and image argument in the proof, so the result is not a one- or two-line special case of a single Mathlib declaration.
